title: Berakhot: Entering the opening sugya
audience: English-speaking beginners who can sound out Hebrew
outcome: The learner can orient to a Mishnah, identify a Gemara question, explain an answer rooted in a verse, and request translation without leaving the source page.

lessons.title: A Mishnah begins with a question
lessons.evidence: Identify the practical question in the opening Mishnah.

lessons.title: Recognize me'eimatai
lessons.evidence: Recognize that me'eimatai asks for a beginning time.

lessons.title: What is the Gemara asking?
lessons.evidence: Explain why the Gemara asks what context the Mishnah addresses.

lessons.title: Read an answer with a verse
lessons.evidence: State what the verse adds to the Mishnah’s order.

lessons.title: A word can become a problem
lessons.evidence: Use the surrounding text to identify what the Gemara investigates in ve-taher.

lessons.title: Trace the opening movement
lessons.evidence: Map Mishnah, question, answer, and textual support in order.

review_policy: Return incomplete or uncertain skills in the next session; expand successful retrieval intervals from one day to two weeks.
